from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class QuarterlyFinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """One quarterly financial report with operating revenue data."""
    year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year this quarter belongs to")
    quarter: str | None = Field(description="The quarter (e.g., 'Q1', '一季度')")
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name the report belongs to")
    operating_revenue: float | None = Field(description="Operating revenue amount as reported")
    revenue_currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the revenue (e.g., 'CNY', '元', 'yuan')")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The label used for operating revenue in the report (e.g., '营业总收入', '营业收入')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the reported figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    quarterly_reports: list[QuarterlyFinancialReport]
